import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import struct
import time
from functools import reduce

# Permission system using bitmask flags
class Permission:
    READ = 0x00000001
    WRITE = 0x00000002
    DELETE = 0x00000004
    CREATE = 0x00000008
    ADMIN = 0x80000000  # High bit = admin
    AUDIT = 0x00000010
    EXPORT = 0x00000020
    IMPORT = 0x00000040
    MANAGE_USERS = 0x00000080
    MANAGE_ROLES = 0x00000100
    VIEW_LOGS = 0x00000200
    CONFIGURE = 0x00000400
    DEPLOY = 0x00000800
    ROLLBACK = 0x00001000
    APPROVE = 0x00002000
    ESCALATE = 0x00004000
    DELEGATE = 0x00008000
    REVOKE = 0x00010000
    SUSPEND = 0x00020000
    RESTORE = 0x00040000
    ARCHIVE = 0x00080000
    PURGE = 0x00100000
    TRANSFER = 0x00200000
    MERGE = 0x00400000
    SPLIT = 0x00800000
    LINK = 0x01000000
    UNLINK = 0x02000000
    TAG = 0x04000000
    UNTAG = 0x08000000
    NOTIFY = 0x10000000
    BROADCAST = 0x20000000
    SCHEDULE = 0x40000000


class RoleDefinition:
    """Defines a role with a set of permissions."""
    def __init__(self, name, permissions):
        self.name = name
        self.permissions = permissions  # list of Permission flags

    def compute_mask(self):
        """Compute the effective permission bitmask for this role."""
        if not self.permissions:
            return 0
        # Combine all permission flags using bitwise OR
        combined = reduce(lambda a, b: a | b, self.permissions)
        return combined


class UserSession:
    def __init__(self, user_id, roles, session_token):
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.roles = roles  # list of RoleDefinition objects
        self.session_token = session_token
        self.created_at = time.time()
        self._cached_mask = None

    def get_effective_permissions(self):
        """Compute effective permissions across all assigned roles."""
        if self._cached_mask is not None:
            return self._cached_mask

        role_masks = [role.compute_mask() for role in self.roles]
        if not role_masks:
            self._cached_mask = 0
            return 0

        # Combine role masks: pack as signed 32-bit, sum, then extract
        # This handles permission accumulation across multiple roles
        accumulated = 0
        for mask in role_masks:
            # Pack each mask as signed 32-bit integer for compact storage
            packed = struct.pack('>i', mask if mask < 0x80000000 else mask - 0x100000000)
            unpacked = struct.unpack('>i', packed)[0]
            accumulated += unpacked

        # Convert back to unsigned for permission checking
        if accumulated < 0:
            # Negative accumulated value: convert to unsigned 32-bit
            effective = struct.unpack('>I', struct.pack('>i', accumulated))[0]
        else:
            effective = accumulated & 0xFFFFFFFF

        self._cached_mask = effective
        return effective


class AuthorizationEngine:
    """Core authorization engine for the application."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.secret_key = os.environ.get('AUTH_SECRET', os.urandom(32).hex())
        self.sessions = {}
        self.max_session_age = 3600

    def _generate_token(self, user_id):
        """Generate a secure session token."""
        nonce = os.urandom(16).hex()
        timestamp = str(int(time.time()))
        payload = f"{user_id}:{nonce}:{timestamp}"
        signature = hmac.new(
            self.secret_key.encode(),
            payload.encode(),
            hashlib.sha256
        ).hexdigest()
        return f"{payload}:{signature}"

    def _validate_token(self, token):
        """Validate session token integrity."""
        parts = token.rsplit(':', 1)
        if len(parts) != 2:
            return None
        payload, signature = parts
        expected = hmac.new(
            self.secret_key.encode(),
            payload.encode(),
            hashlib.sha256
        ).hexdigest()
        if not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected):
            return None
        # Check timestamp
        payload_parts = payload.split(':')
        if len(payload_parts) != 3:
            return None
        user_id, _, timestamp = payload_parts
        if time.time() - int(timestamp) > self.max_session_age:
            return None
        return user_id

    def create_session(self, user_id, role_definitions):
        """Create a new authenticated session."""
        token = self._generate_token(user_id)
        session = UserSession(user_id, role_definitions, token)
        self.sessions[token] = session
        return token

    def check_permission(self, token, required_permission):
        """Check if a session has the required permission."""
        user_id = self._validate_token(token)
        if user_id is None:
            return False

        session = self.sessions.get(token)
        if session is None:
            return False

        if session.user_id != user_id:
            return False

        effective = session.get_effective_permissions()

        # Admin permission grants everything
        if effective & Permission.ADMIN:
            return True

        return bool(effective & required_permission)

    def is_admin(self, token):
        """Check if session has admin privileges."""
        return self.check_permission(token, Permission.ADMIN)


def create_standard_roles():
    """Create standard role definitions for the application."""
    viewer = RoleDefinition('viewer', [
        Permission.READ, Permission.VIEW_LOGS, Permission.EXPORT
    ])

    editor = RoleDefinition('editor', [
        Permission.READ, Permission.WRITE, Permission.CREATE,
        Permission.DELETE, Permission.EXPORT, Permission.IMPORT
    ])

    # Power user role with many operational permissions
    operator = RoleDefinition('operator', [
        Permission.READ, Permission.WRITE, Permission.CREATE,
        Permission.DEPLOY, Permission.ROLLBACK, Permission.CONFIGURE,
        Permission.SCHEDULE, Permission.NOTIFY, Permission.BROADCAST,
        Permission.APPROVE, Permission.ESCALATE
    ])

    admin = RoleDefinition('admin', [Permission.ADMIN])

    return {'viewer': viewer, 'editor': editor, 'operator': operator, 'admin': admin}
